trialSignIn.title: Sign in and clear the trial chart?
trialSignIn.message: Signing in to an existing account clears the trial chart on this device. To keep it, download its PDF first — or create a free account instead, which keeps it.

speciesChange.title: Change species or dentition?
speciesChange.messageGrid: Cats, dogs and deciduous teeth use different tooth numbering, so this clears the charting grid. Patient details and exam findings stay.
speciesChange.messageDiagram: Cats, dogs and deciduous teeth use different tooth numbering, so this clears the diagram marks, notes and drawings. Patient details and exam findings stay.
speciesChange.messageBoth: Cats, dogs and deciduous teeth use different tooth numbering, so this clears the charting grid and the diagram marks, notes and drawings. Patient details and exam findings stay.

sync.historyNotSetUp: Chart history isn’t set up on the server yet.
sync.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again, then save — your chart is still here on this device.
sync.notAllowed: This chart couldn't be saved to your account. Contact your practice owner if this keeps happening.
sync.tooLarge: This chart is too large to save (usually too many or too big images). Remove an attachment and retry.
sync.offline: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and retry — your chart is safe on this device.
sync.saveFailed: Save failed: {{message}}. Your chart is safe on this device — retry in a moment.
sync.changedByOther: This chart was changed by someone else — reopen it from My charts to see their version.
sync.notSavedConflict: Not saved — this chart was changed by someone else. Reopen it from My charts to see their version.
sync.noPermission: You don’t have permission to save changes to this chart. Ask the practice owner, or start a new visit.

conflict.title: This chart changed somewhere else
conflict.message: It was saved at {{when}} — by a teammate or on another device — after you opened it here. Saving now replaces those changes with yours.

duplicate.message: This new chart would be a second visit on the same day. Open the existing visit instead, or keep both? Opening it discards what you’ve entered in this new chart.

openOther.message: This chart has changes that aren’t saved to the cloud yet. Open the other chart anyway? To keep them, cancel and press Save first.

restore.message: This chart has changes that aren’t saved to the cloud yet. Restore this version anyway? To keep them, cancel and press Save first.

signOut.message: This chart has changes that aren’t saved to the cloud yet. Sign out anyway? To keep them, cancel and press Save first.

newVisit.message: This chart has changes that aren’t saved to the cloud yet. Start a new visit anyway? To keep them, cancel and press Save first.

newPatient.message: This chart has changes that aren’t saved to the cloud yet. Start a new patient anyway? To keep them, cancel and press Save first.

importPdf.message: This chart has changes that aren’t saved to the cloud yet. Import this PDF anyway? To keep them, cancel and press Save first.

storage.full: This browser’s storage is full — recent changes may not be kept on this device. Save the chart or download its PDF.
